# UI Bakery

> > UI Bakery is a low-code platform for building internal tools, admin panels, and dashboards with visual development and integrations for PostgreSQL, MongoDB, AWS Lambda, and enterprise systems.

UI Bakery enables developers and citizen developers to rapidly create data-driven applications using drag-and-drop components, connecting to databases like PostgreSQL, MySQL, DynamoDB, and services like Salesforce, HubSpot, and Twilio. The platform emphasizes visual development workflows while maintaining flexibility for JavaScript customization.
